description: This file defines a Debug controller class in the OpenCart admin module that records method execution times for debugging purposes. It provides 'before' and 'after' hooks to timestamp and log route execution durations.

classes.name: Debug
classes.description: A controller class for debugging, extending the core Controller class, providing hooks to measure execution time of routes.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Records the current time for a route to measure its execution duration.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Calculates the elapsed time since 'before' was called for the route and logs the route name.
